start.title: The Holy City
start.text:
Jerusalem shines in golden light.
Jesus walks toward her gates.

choices.text: Push ahead to claim a place
Hang back, afraid to be seen

push_consequence.title: Be Still
push_consequence.text:
His coming needs no rushing.
Fall back into his step.

hang_consequence.title: Come Closer
hang_consequence.text:
Today is for being near him.
Draw close.

donkey.title: Bring the Colt
donkey.text:
Two disciples return with a young donkey.
"The Lord has need of it."

choices.text: Lay your cloak on its back

horse_consequence.title: Not a War King
horse_consequence.text:
He chose the colt to fulfill the word.
Honor his choice.

choices.text: Lay your cloak on its back
choices.feedback: You bow and place it down.

ride.title: The Prophecy
ride.text:
He rides as Zechariah foretold.
"Your king comes, humble and gentle."

choices.feedback: What is humble is what is holy.
Fear is not the road today.

mock_consequence.title: Do Not Mock
mock_consequence.text:
Humility is the throne of God.
Receive what you see.

worry_consequence.title: Be Not Afraid
worry_consequence.text:
Today is for joy, not fear.
Lift your head.

cloaks.title: A Royal Road
cloaks.text:
Villagers spread their cloaks for him.
The ground becomes a carpet.

choices.text: Lay your cloak on the road

keep_consequence.title: Give Freely
keep_consequence.text:
What you keep cannot honor him.
Open your hands.

choices.text: Lay your cloak on the road

palms.title: Branches Lifted
palms.text:
Palm branches sway like green flames.
The air is bright with welcome.

sell_consequence.title: Not For Sale
sell_consequence.text:
This is praise, not profit.
Lift the branch in love.

stiff_consequence.title: Let Joy Move You
stiff_consequence.text:
If you are silent, the stones will sing.
Join the song.

hosanna.title: Hosanna in the Highest
hosanna.text:
"Blessed is he who comes
in the name of the Lord!"

choices.feedback: He is a king of peace.

political_consequence.title: A Different Crown
political_consequence.text:
He brings a kingdom not of swords.
Sing of peace instead.

pharisees.title: Quiet Your Disciples
pharisees.text:
Pharisees frown at the song.
"Teacher, silence your people."

choices.feedback: Do not quiet what God stirs.

hush_consequence.title: Do Not Silence Joy
hush_consequence.text:
What God has opened, do not close.
Sing on.

argue_consequence.title: Praise, Not Quarrel
argue_consequence.text:
Let his presence answer them.
Return to the song.

enter.title: The King Enters
enter.text:
He passes through the gate in peace.
The city receives her humble King.

slip_consequence.title: Stay With Him
slip_consequence.text:
Today is the day to follow.
Return to his side.

ending.title: Blessed Is He
ending.text:
A humble King has entered.
Prophecy walks through the gate.
